Agent Krzeminski is shot dead by an unseen assassin while driving a captured guard back to SSR headquarters.

CIA Deputy Director Marion James tells Madani to stay out of it and let Frank and Billy Russo kill each other.

Nadeem testifies against Fisk before a grand jury, but Fisk controls the jurors and the hearing changes nothing.

Bakuto, secretly a leader of the Hand, visits Harold Meachum and offers him a partnership.

item.name: The Castle family
step: In episode 10, Frank's wife Maria and their children, Lisa and Frank Jr., die in a gang shootout in Central Park during a sting the DA let go ahead.

entries: Tony and Pepper are out jogging in Central Park when Doctor Strange steps through a portal, with Bruce Banner behind him.

item.name: Oscar Clemons
step: In episode 10, Detective Clemons doubts Jessica, then guards the proof of Kilgrave's power until Will Simpson kills him.

entries: Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson open a law practice, and at night Matt puts on a mask.

Jessica brings Ruben's head to the 15th Precinct to get herself locked up, and Kilgrave takes control of every officer in the station, Mahoney among them.
Oscar breaks things off with Jessica, telling her he has met someone else.
With Matt missing, Foggy thinks about leaving the law to help his brother Theo run the family butcher shop.

Rawlins and Billy Russo torture Frank for a password in Micro's old hideout, until Russo quietly cuts him loose and Frank kills Rawlins.
Kate Bishop puts on Ronin's suit at an underground auction, and Clint comes to find out who she is.
Four years on, Spider-Man takes down Tombstone, Ramrod and Boomerang across the city.
Joy drugs Danny in her office and has him locked up at Birch Psychiatric Hospital.
In 2021, Maya watches the Ronin kill her father and his Tracksuit crew, then fights Daredevil on her first job for Fisk.
Kamala Khan visits Kate Bishop and Lucky the dog at Kate's apartment to recruit her for a new team of young heroes.

Sousa exposes Peggy to Dooley, and as the SSR raids the Griffith, Angie helps her hide, until Dottie knocks her out and the agents arrest her.
Agent Krzeminski is shot dead by an unseen assassin while driving a captured guard back to SSR headquarters.
Trish helps Jessica hunt Gregory Sallinger, who murders Trish's mother Dorothy at her apartment.
Lewis Wilson attacks Senator Ori's fundraiser at a hotel in a bomb vest and takes Karen hostage, until Frank frees her and Lewis blows himself up. Detective Mahoney then questions the survivors.

CIA Deputy Director Marion James tells Madani to stay out of it and let Frank and Billy Russo kill each other.

After the attack on the Bulletin, Ellison orders Karen to name Daredevil or quit.
Dex attacks the Bulletin in Daredevil's suit and kills Jasper Evans before he can talk about Fisk.
Nadeem testifies against Fisk before a grand jury, but Fisk controls the jurors and the hearing changes nothing.
Yelena waits for Kate in her apartment and reveals she has come to kill Clint, whom she blames for Natasha's death.
Clint and Kate trace the stolen watch to Maya Lopez's apartment, where Maya, hunting the Ronin who killed her father, attacks Kate.
Bakuto, secretly a leader of the Hand, visits Harold Meachum and offers him a partnership.

item.name: Dottie Underwood
step: In episode 14, Peggy breaks Dottie out of an FBI prison and sends her with Jarvis to a fundraiser to take a Zero Matter blood sample from Whitney Frost, which she does. She then sneaks off to spy on a secret Council meeting, and Thompson knocks her out and hands her over to Frost.

entries: Simon Williams chases the lead in Von Kovak's remake of Wonder Man.
A Mandarin bombing outside the Chinese Theatre puts Happy in the hospital.
Damage Control's agent Cleary offers Trevor Slattery his freedom to spy on Simon, and Trevor secretly hacks Simon's computer while helping him film an audition.
Some time earlier, the doorman DeMarr Davis gains powers and becomes a film star until the actor who cast him vanishes inside him on set, and Hollywood's studios ban powered people from acting.

item.name: Dottie Underwood
step: In episode 15, Dottie shrugs off Masters' truth serum, but Frost tortures her into revealing Wilkes, and her tracker is used to lure Peggy and Jarvis into a trap. After they all get free, Peggy locks her in the car trunk while they rush Jarvis's wounded wife, Ana, to a hospital, and there she breaks out and escapes.

item.name: Daisy Johnson
step: In episode 123, Daisy leads a search through space for Fitz, then returns to Earth to fight Sarge and Izel.

entries: Fitz wagers himself in a casino game where the losers are sold.

item.name: Gambit
step: In episode 53, after Fabian Cortez captures and tortures him on Asteroid M, Gambit shields Nightcrawler from a mob in Germany.

entries: Fabian Cortez takes over Magneto's orbiting haven and fires hundreds of missiles at Earth, until Magneto returns and destroys both the missiles and the asteroid.
Magneto restores his orbiting haven and turns his back on Earth, and Rogue and Sunspot join him there.
Bastion tries to crash the asteroid into Earth, until U.S. missiles strike it and kill him.

item.name: Monica Rambeau
step: In episode 4, Monica returns from the Blip to find her mother has died, then is pulled into the Westview Hex while investigating it for S.W.O.R.D.

entries: Wanda turns a small town into a sitcom inside a hex of red energy.
Teen tells Agatha he is the one who broke Wanda's spell on her, and asks her to take him down the Witches' Road.
Escaping into her own backyard at the end of the Road, Agatha kisses Rio, who is Death, and dies.
Wanda gives birth to twins, Billy and Tommy.
Rio Vidal wakes Agatha from Wanda's spell, and Agatha finds her powers are gone.
Hayward tries to shoot Wanda's sons, but Monica stops him and Darcy blocks his escape. He is later arrested.
In her basement, Agatha mocks Wanda for believing the impostor "Pietro" was her dead brother.
A man calling himself Pietro, though he looks different, turns up at Wanda's door.
"Pietro" takes the twins trick-or-treating and causes mischief at super speed, until he jokes about Vision's death and Wanda blasts him aside.
"Pietro" catches Monica as she finds the way into Agnes's basement.
Billy comes back to Westview, seals the entrance to the Road, and sets out with Agatha's ghost to find Tommy.

item.name: Afterlife
step: In episode 44, Jiaying leads Afterlife into war on S.H.I.E.L.D., and the haven is lost when she and Gordon are killed.

entries: Skye is brought to Afterlife, a hidden Inhuman haven where Jiaying guides new Inhumans through their changes.
Jiaying leads the Inhumans of Afterlife and helps Skye learn to control her powers.
Jiaying hands Cal over to Gonzales at Afterlife, then kills Gonzales and shoots herself to make it look like a S.H.I.E.L.D. attack.
Jiaying kills Raina when she threatens to reveal who really started the war, and Skye, who sees it, turns against her mother.

item.name: Sylvie
step: In episode 3, Sylvie attacks TVA Minutemen and plants reset charges across the Sacred Timeline, then fights Loki at the TVA until he steals her TemPad and takes them both to Lamentis-1.

entries: Sylvie ambushes a TVA squad at a Renaissance fair.

item.name: Sylvie
step: In episode 3, Sylvie attacks TVA Minutemen and plants reset charges across the Sacred Timeline, then fights Loki at the TVA until he steals her TemPad and takes them both to Lamentis-1.

entries: Loki and Mobius track a variant to a Roxxcart superstore where people are sheltering from a hurricane.
Hunter B-15 takes the captured Sylvie back to the Roxxcart store, and Sylvie lets her see the life she had before the TVA.

item.name: HYDRA
step: In episode 33, Daniel Whitehall's HYDRA hunts an alien Obelisk, until Coulson kills him and S.H.I.E.L.D. picks off its leaders.

entries: Inside the alien temple under the city, the Diviner releases Terrigen Mist that changes Skye, and Trip dies trying to stop it.

item.name: Nathan Summers
step: In episode 9, the mercenary Cable helps Gambit escape Genosha, then hunts Apocalypse's agent on Muir Island.

place.r: An island nation off East Africa
entries: Genosha lures mutants with the promise of a haven, then collars them as slaves to build Sentinels, until the X-Men free them.
Magneto gathers his mutant army on Genosha, then calls off the attack when he learns Xavier has been struck down.
The council asks Magneto and Rogue to lead Genosha, but Sentinels strike its UN gala and kill thousands, Gambit among them.
As the X-Men help with the recovery, Emma Frost is pulled alive from the rubble, still in her diamond form.
Psylocke is among the mutants in Genosha's ruins who stand against Bastion's Prime Sentinels.
Banned in the United States, the X-Men follow Xavier to Genosha's ruins, where he founds X-Corp.

item.name: Moira MacTaggert
step: In episode 57, Moira runs her lab on Muir Island and asks the X-Men to help her son, Proteus.

place.r: Off the north coast of Scotland
entries: At Dr. Adler's island clinic, Apocalypse turns cure-seeking mutants into his Horsemen, and Rogue unmasks Adler as Mystique.
Moira MacTaggert's son Proteus breaks out of her island lab, and she calls on the X-Men for help.
Rogue comes to Dr. Adler's island clinic for his mutant cure, while Cable hunts the doctor and Moira tells Xavier she cannot review his work.
While Moira cares for Xavier here, Juggernaut and Black Tom attack the island and carry Lilandra off to Cassidy Keep.

item.name: Vision
step: In episode 2, living in Edinburgh, Vision is hunted by the bounty hunter Paladin and rescues Tommy, who claims to be his son.

entries: Proxima Midnight and Corvus Glaive ambush Wanda and Vision in the streets.
Vision works at Fiona Guthrie's pub until Paladin's mercenaries attack it to capture him, and Fiona is killed in the crossfire.
